12. REMOVE UPPER WINDOW STOPS
Remove the 2 bolts and 2 upper window stops.
Torque: 11 N-m {115 kgf-cm, 8 ft-lbf)
13. REMOVE DOOR GLASS
(a) Close the door glass until the nuts appear in the service
hole.
(b) Remove the 3 nuts.
Torque: 7.8 N-m (80 kgf-cm, 69 in .. Jbf)
(c) Take the door glass out of the panel carefully.
NOTICE:
Be careful not to drop the door glass.
HINT:
• At the time of reassembly, please refer to the following
item.
• Insert a shop rag inside the panel to prevent the glass
from being scratched.
